newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Ixe names new director of exchange house.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ixe names new director of exchange house.

text.p: Mexico's IXE Grupo Financiero said on Sunday it has named Martin Diaz Alvarez as director of its subsidiary, the currency exchange house Consultoria Internacional Casa de Cambio.
Diaz previously was Ixe's director of international consulting and director of Ixe's international capital markets division, Ixe said in a news release.
He replaces Miguel Angel Guzman, but Ixe did not say why Guzman left his former post.
Consultoria Internacional is Mexico's leading non-bank currency exchange firm with 70 branches and has plans to increase to 100 branches in the near future, Ixe said.
